summary: For c1, the old harness initializes notes through read_begin before the assembly pass in the before version. In the after version, initialization has moved to main, which the harness bypasses.

claims.necessity_reason: Necessity was established in the review; this turn assesses when the fixed harness satisfies the obligation.

before.requirement: Initialize notes before the assembly pass creates sections and allocates notes-backed section information.
before.reason: The harness calls read_begin before perform_an_assembly_pass, and the before version initializes notes in read_begin.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Section information is allocated from notes.

after.requirement: Initialize notes before the assembly pass creates sections and allocates notes-backed section information.
after.reason: The after version initializes notes in main, while read_begin no longer does so. The harness bypasses main and proceeds to the assembly pass.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Section information is allocated from notes.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The fixed harness calls read_begin and perform_an_assembly_pass without calling main.

claims.comparison_reason: Moving notes initialization from read_begin to main changes the same harness from satisfying the prerequisite to missing it.
